CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.description: User input concatenated into SQL queries allows attackers to modify query logic

fix_strategies.name: Parameterized Query
fix_strategies.description: Replace string concatenation/template literals with parameterized placeholders

fix_strategies.name: ORM Method
fix_strategies.description: Use ORM's built-in methods instead of raw SQL

fix_strategies.name: Input Validation + Cast
fix_strategies.description: Validate and cast input to expected type before use
fix_strategies.pattern: const id = parseInt(req.params.id, 10); if (isNaN(id)) return res.status(400).send('Invalid ID');

CWE-79.name: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
CWE-79.description: User input rendered in HTML without escaping allows script injection

fix_strategies.name: Output Encoding
fix_strategies.description: Escape HTML entities before rendering user content

fix_strategies.name: DOMPurify Sanitization
fix_strategies.description: Sanitize HTML before rendering if HTML is required

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.description: User input passed to shell commands allows arbitrary command execution

fix_strategies.name: execFile with Arguments Array
fix_strategies.description: Use execFile/spawn with args array instead of exec with string interpolation

fix_strategies.name: Input Allowlist
fix_strategies.description: Validate input against a strict allowlist pattern

CWE-22.name: Path Traversal
CWE-22.description: User input in file paths allows reading/writing arbitrary files

fix_strategies.name: Basename Extraction
fix_strategies.description: Use only the filename, stripping all path components

fix_strategies.name: Path Canonicalization
fix_strategies.description: Resolve the path and verify it's within the allowed directory
fix_strategies.pattern: const resolved = path.resolve(baseDir, userPath); if (!resolved.startsWith(baseDir)) throw new Error('Access denied');

CWE-798.name: Hardcoded Credentials
CWE-798.description: Secrets hardcoded in source code are exposed in version control

CWE-918.name: Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
CWE-918.description: User-controlled URLs allow fetching internal resources

fix_strategies.name: URL Validation + Private IP Block
fix_strategies.description: Parse URL and block requests to private/internal IPs
fix_strategies.pattern: const parsed = new URL(userUrl); const ip = dns.resolve(parsed.hostname); if (isPrivateIP(ip)) throw new Error('Blocked');

fix_strategies.name: URL Allowlist
fix_strategies.description: Only allow requests to known-safe domains
fix_strategies.pattern: const allowed = ['api.example.com']; if (!allowed.includes(parsed.hostname)) throw new Error('Not allowed');

CWE-942.name: Permissive CORS Policy
CWE-942.description: Wildcard CORS allows any origin to access the API

fix_strategies.name: Origin Allowlist
fix_strategies.description: Replace wildcard with specific allowed origins

CWE-693.name: Missing Security Headers
CWE-693.description: Response headers don't include standard security protections

fix_strategies.name: Helmet Middleware
fix_strategies.description: Add helmet or equivalent security headers middleware

CWE-614.name: Cookie Without Secure Flag
CWE-614.description: Session cookies sent over HTTP can be intercepted

fix_strategies.name: Secure Cookie Flags
fix_strategies.description: Set secure, httpOnly, and sameSite flags on cookies
fix_strategies.pattern: res.cookie('session', token, { secure: true, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'strict' });

CWE-287.name: Improper Authentication

fix_strategies.name: Authentication Middleware
fix_strategies.description: Add authentication middleware to protected routes

anti_patterns: no auth check before sensitive operation
